status: DRAFT 3 FOR OWNER REVIEW. Frozen with the protocol at approval (section 12). Read by prospective/budget.py; a price of null refuses every request to that provider. Prices are entered by the owner from the provider's price page, with the date, before any paid call. Nothing here authorises a call.

gemini.daily_limit_source: observed in v1: about 20 successful calls a day (MODEL_ACCESS.md); an assumption, not a quota the provider guarantees

gemini.price_source: to be read by the owner from Google's price page and entered here, with the date, before authorisation

openrouter.price_source: OpenRouter model listing read on 2026-11-15 (MODEL_ACCESS.md); to be re-read before authorisation

reissue.reissuable: a call none of whose attempts succeeded and whose last failure was a transport failure, HTTP 429, HTTP 5xx or a refusal by the daily request limit; never a call refused by a cost cap, a deterministic failure (HTTP 400-404, an answer without text) or an answer that does not parse
reissue.before: step 4 of protocol 6 (no verification result exists while calls are re-issued)

billing_assumptions: An attempt is charged the usage the provider reports. Without reported usage, a transport failure, a time-out or a server error is charged its worst case (it may have been billed); an HTTP 4xx answer is charged nothing. To be reconciled with the providers' statements after the run.
